verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile's evidence covers PR review, issues, notifications, code search, and Copilot agent tasks. None of it documents an in-app terminal or SSH session, let alone session persistence across network changes or device sleep. Terminal access is a plausible axis for a mobile developer app, so this is 'none' rather than 'na'. The GitHub CLI and Copilot CLI items describe separate desktop terminal tools, not a capability of the mobile app, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can keep my terminal session alive across network changes and device sleep
